items.title: Bosshogg Macaroni is live!

chunks.text: The control that matters is control of yourself, your money, and your discipline. A habit that runs you, or money with no plan, means you have already slipped. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=28
If you cannot see a journey through, do not start by spending other people's time. Discipline is the price of asking anyone to walk with you. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=96

Building money is not only what you make. It is what you keep, and it includes spending less than you bring in. Getting paid and keeping it are both jobs. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=134
Do not pretend you already earn a life you have not earned. Also do not freeze today's paycheck as your ceiling. Both mistakes keep you stuck. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=198
Raise what you can earn on purpose. School, the gym, a mentor, and a seminar are ways of moving, not decorations. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=270
A big dream needs someone nearby who will say the real numbers. Dreaming without that check becomes a leak. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=276
One paycheck is thin. A job plus a trade, or a job plus a business, gives you more than one way to stand. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=480
Find one clear way you help the person you serve. If you cannot name that help, the offer is still a wish. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=960
Confidence and faith do different work, and you need both before you move. One without the other stalls the step. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=1440
Do not pour out every lesson the first time you speak. Keep some of what you know, and teach the piece the moment can hold. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=1920
Being right is less useful than handling the business and staying connected to the people who are in it with you. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=2400
People who work together need the same agenda. Checking the plan is part of the job. It is not the same thing as being cruel. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QgHO13beIo&t=3360

items.attribution: Original Brimmesa lesson notes for Coach Amara from Bosshogg Macaroni, YouTube live -QgHO13beIo, channel https://www.youtube.com/@bosshoggmacaroni6462, about 63 minutes. Not a transcript and not the speaker's words. Profanity and material about controlling other people were left out. The notes teach self-control, money, and discipline.
